preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to exploit the floating pragma vulnerability

exploit_hint: The floating pragma ^0.6.12 allows the contract to be compiled with different compiler versions that may have different behaviors. As the owner, you can exploit this by: 1) Deploying a malicious contract that takes advantage of compiler version differences, 2) Using owner privileges to call setAddressFee() or other functions to manipulate fees for specific addresses, 3) Setting custom buy/sell fees for attacker-controlled addresses to bypass normal fee structures. The exploit leverages the owner's ability to configure custom fee structures for specific addresses.
